name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2480: His ask: sync them, no reason for the mismatch. The mismatch was not an accident - there are TWO PRODUCERS with two spellings. ct.detect reports unique, and the templates marker box is keyed on that word; READ_PROMPT asks the model for uniques. Each resolver understood only its own producer, so unique resolved through ledger_kind_for_tab and returned None from chronicle_kind, uniques did the reverse, and sets agreed only by luck of spelling. Renaming either side would have broken that sides producer, so instead there is ONE alias map in chronicle_template and every resolver quotes it. There were FOUR copies, not two: lane_lock kept its own plural-only list and was what still blocked chronicle_kind after the first three were joined, and chronicle_kind ended with a ledger name built by string concatenation - right only because those two words pluralise correctly, and it would have returned chronicle-unique for the templates spelling. All four now agree, runewords still resolves as a lane while having no ledger because those are two different facts, and lane_locks own ledger names are unchanged because callers use them as identifiers.
